webhooks.intro: Raavi calls the address you give with a signed POST when the chosen events happen. The body names the event and the ids involved (space, page, user) — never titles or text. Failed deliveries are retried automatically.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.confirmDelete: Delete the webhook “{name}” and its delivery log?
webhooks.secretOnce: Copy this secret now. It is not shown again; if you lose it, create a new one.
webhooks.verify: Every request carries X-Raavi-Signature: t=<unix time>,v1=<hex>. Compute HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the secret and compare; reject old timestamps.

export.title: Data export
export.intro: Download a ZIP archive of the content of this workspace as JSON files (plus the attached files), for backup, audits or moving to another system.
export.i1: Spaces with their current pages: title, hierarchy, labels, the published body, comments and attachments.
export.i2: Tasks, calendar events, databases with their rows, slide decks and whiteboards (JSON, and SVG for boards).
export.i3: A manifest with counts, what was left out, and a list of the people named in the data.
export.n1: Pages you cannot view (restricted pages, private spaces you are not part of).
export.n2: Drafts, archived and deleted content, and page history.
export.n3: Permissions, notification settings, AI and webhook configuration, secrets and sessions.
export.scopeNote: The export contains what you, as the signed-in administrator, may view. A complete dump of the whole workspace is a separate operation for the installation administrator.
export.failed: The export could not be created. Try again later.
export.inProgress: An export of this workspace is already running. Try again in a few minutes.

body_invalid.1: Press Ctrl+Z inside the editor to undo your last change. The usual cause is a half-finished block (an empty table, diagram or formula).
body_invalid.2: Look through the page for a block that shows an error or a red frame and delete or correct it.
body_invalid.3: If you pasted text from Word, a web page or another program: select it, cut it, and paste it again as plain text (Ctrl+Shift+V), then format it in the editor.
body_invalid.4: Still rejected? Copy your text somewhere safe, reload the page, and add your change back in small pieces to find the piece that is refused.

schema_unsupported.1: The server was upgraded since you opened this page. Reload the page (Ctrl+F5) and open it again.
schema_unsupported.2: If it still fails, ask your administrator whether all parts of the system were upgraded together.

length.1: Use at least 12 characters. A short sentence of unrelated words is easy to remember and strong.
length.2: Do not use spaces only or the same character repeated.

too_simple.1: Avoid common words, keyboard runs (qwerty, 123456) and names. Mix words, digits and a symbol.
too_simple.2: A sentence of 3–4 unrelated words, such as "blue-river-coffee-42", is both strong and easy to remember.

contains_email.1: Do not include the first part of the e-mail address (before the {'@'}) in the password. Choose something unrelated.

account_shared.1: This person also belongs to another workspace (or the system), so only they can change their own password and picture.
account_shared.2: To give them access again, send an invitation or ask them to use the sign-in help of their own account.

type_invalid.1: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture. SVG and GIF files are not accepted.

too_large.1: Pick a smaller picture, or crop it tighter; the cropped logo must be under 256 KB.

status.title: System status
status.footer: Environment: {env} · figures cover the last 60 minutes of this server process.

overallHelp.Healthy: Raavi is up and every check passed.
overallHelp.Degraded: Raavi answers, but something needs attention (see the list below). Some features may be on hold.
overallHelp.Unhealthy: A critical part is down. People will see errors until it is fixed.
overallHelp.Unreachable: This page cannot get an answer from the API. The numbers below are the last known ones and are greyed out.

fix.workers: Install and start the RaaviWorkers service (see the install guide, section 6).
fix.outbox: Events are waiting for the worker: check that the RaaviWorkers service runs and its log has no errors.
fix.sql_speed: Check the SQL Server load, locks and the network path to it.
fix.sql: Check that SQL Server is running and the connection string of the application pool is right.
fix.disk: Free disk space on the drive of the application (backups, logs, attachments).

kpi.roundTripHelp: From your browser to the API and back

unreachable.title: The API cannot be reached
unreachable.since: Unreachable for {time} · {tries} failed checks in a row.
unreachable.stale: The figures and components below are from the last successful check and may be out of date.

network.1: Check your own network or VPN connection and try opening another site.
network.2: If only this site fails: the web site (IIS "RaaviWeb") may be stopped, or a firewall blocks the port.
network.3: On the server, open the site in a browser to see whether the problem is only on your side.
network.what: Your browser cannot reach the web server at all.

gateway.1: In IIS, make sure the application pool "RaaviAPI" and the site "RaaviApi" are started (a stopped or crashed pool is the usual cause).
gateway.2: On the server run: Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:5180/health/ready -UseBasicParsing
gateway.3: Open the Windows Event Log (Application) or the API log folder for the start-up error: wrong connection string, SQL Server stopped, or a missing .NET runtime.
gateway.4: If the API was just restarted, wait up to a minute: the first start is slow.
gateway.what: The web server answers, but it cannot reach the API behind it (HTTP 502, 503 or 504).

notApi.1: The proxy rule is missing or wrong: the web.config of the web site must forward /health, /api and /hubs to the API.
notApi.2: Check that the URL Rewrite and ARR modules are installed and the proxy is enabled.
notApi.3: Check that this address is served by the Raavi web site and not by another site.
notApi.what: Something answered, but it was not the Raavi API (a web page instead of data).

disabled.1: An administrator set Raavi:Health:PublicStatus to false. The sign-in pages still work.
disabled.what: The API is running, but the public status is switched off.

timeout.1: The API may be overloaded or still starting: wait a minute and check again.
timeout.2: Check CPU, memory and the SQL Server on the server.
timeout.3: If it keeps happening, recycle the application pool "RaaviAPI".
timeout.what: The server did not answer in time.

workers.fix: Start it on the server (PowerShell as administrator):

systemUsers.intro: Every account of the installation and the number of workspaces it belongs to. Accounts without any workspace (left over after workspaces were deleted) can be removed; accounts that still belong to a workspace and system administrators cannot.
